ngaap.guidance: Second half calendar 2019 (two quarters ending 3-Jan-2020): revenue ~$9.2 billion, up ~10% vs combined 2H18 (previously $9.2 - $9.3 billion); GAAP EPS ~$3.81 and non-GAAP EPS ~$5.35 (previously $2.31 - $2.41 GAAP, $4.95 - $5.05 non-GAAP); operating cash flow ~$834 million; capex ~$190 million; adjusted free cash flow ~$1.35 billion (previously $1.07 - $1.12 billion OCF, $1.30 - $1.35 billion adjusted FCF). Calendar 2019: revenue ~$18.1 billion (previously $18.0 - $18.1); GAAP EPS ~$8.03, non-GAAP EPS ~$10.00 (previously $6.35 - $6.45 / $9.60 - $9.70); operating cash flow ~$1.95 billion; adjusted free cash flow ~$2.35 billion.
ngaap.notes: From this quarter non-GAAP EPS and adjusted EBIT exclude amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (123), merger transaction (135) and integration (146) costs, the inventory fair-value step-up (92), the lease adjustment (12), the Night Vision gain (229) and asset-group gain (12), and debt refinancing losses (1); adjusted EBIT still includes non-operating pension income. For the current quarter the "combined" adjustments are nil except that the margin denominator is combined revenue of 4,408 (reported 4,431 less 23 of Night Vision revenue). Zero-value pro forma rows (pre-merger L3, impact of L3 diluted shares) are dropped from the bridges. Adjusted free cash flow = operating cash flow - net capex (free cash flow (3)) + cash used for merger transaction costs incl. change-in-control payments (251) + integration costs (68) + voluntary pension contribution (302). Pro forma / combined tables exist in this release and are NOT used: the "Three Quarters Ended" / year-to-date columns (calendar-year basis incl. pre-merger L3 for the first half), all prior-year "combined" columns and the combined segment tables in the release text.

notes: is.op_income is computed (sales - cogs - sga - other operating lines); the statement of income prints no operating income line. is.dps: from the 10-Q statement of equity (cash dividends $.75 per share); not printed in the release. bs.tl is computed (total current liabilities + total non-current liabilities); not printed. cf.pension_contrib and cf.pension_income are as presented in the cash flow statement (pension income is a negative non-cash adjustment). is.nci is signed as a deduction (negative = loss attributable to noncontrolling interests added back). bs.st_debt = Short-term debt + Current portion of long-term debt (sum). cf.da = sum of the depreciation / amortization lines where split. cf.divest = sum of the proceeds-from-sale lines (businesses, discontinued operations, asset group, adjustments). is.lines_raw and segments are from the release quarter column; cf.lines_raw and bs.lines_raw are from the 10-Q (the release cash flow and balance sheet are condensed: e.g. it combines "Pension income and share-based compensation" 85 and prints no current-asset / liability totals). The 10-Q cash flow is for the quarter, which is the year-to-date period of the fiscal transition period (ytd_months 3). cf.acquisitions = +1,132 net cash ACQUIRED in the all-stock L3Harris merger (an inflow). Non-operating income 79 = pension adjustment 80 + other (1) (10-Q). Self-checks: all pass.
